rules.title: Sentence case (Capital only for the first word).
rules.journal_name: Italicized, abbreviated according to ISO (no periods except end).

journal.example: Kusrini MD, Lubis MI, Endarwin W, et al. 2017. Elevation range shift after 40 years: the amphibians of Mount Gede Pangrango National Park revisited. Biol Conserv. 206:75−84. doi:10.1016/j.biocon.2016.12.018.

rules.title: Title case (Capital for every main word).
rules.edition: Ed ke-x. or xth ed. (placed after title).
rules.city: City name. US cities add state code in brackets, e.g., 'New York (NY)'.

book.example: Satria A. 2015. Politik Kelautan dan Perikanan. Jakarta: Obor.

thesis.example: Febrizal R. 2017. Pengembangan metode pengukuran tingkat kematangan buah jambu kristal menggunakan pengolahan citra [skripsi]. Bogor: Institut Pertanian Bogor.

rules.access_date: Mandatory if no DOI. Format: [diakses YYYY Mon DD].

electronic_journal.example: Septiadi D, Harianto, Suharno. 2016. Dampak kebijakan harga beras dan luas areal irigasi terhadap pengentasan kemiskinan di Indonesia. J Agribis Indones. [diakses 2017 Nov 21]; 4(2):91-106. http://journal.ipb.ac.id/index.php/jagbi/article/viewFile/17090/12388.
